authorization.user_instruction: 继续完成这三个方向，不断修正完善，直到有稳定的正向增益
authorization.scope: new documented hypotheses, isolated implementations, finite registered server experiments and independent confirmations

objective: stable attributable MaskCO online utility on pickup and delivery; accurate reproducible scientific reporting on the negative-result line
not_guaranteed: No positive outcome is promised; exhausted hypotheses and negative results remain evidence.

validation.selection: Select at most one frozen candidate per registered confirmation family using development only; never tune on confirmation
validation.stable_online: Three fresh 40-complete-day cohorts, every cohort passes main and attribution gates, all hard, complete independently checked source/weight/data/contract/budget identity and raw trajectory replay.
validation.pickup_main: I3-derived new method minus cond_hist >=20 utility/day and paired CI lower>0; minus same-init reconstruction-only control mean>0 and CI lower>0. Also compare qualified same-contract strong rolling controller before stronger efficiency claims.
validation.delivery_main: Against each registered random/nonlearned and qualified strong rolling control, mean relative complete-cost reduction>=1% and paired CI lower>0; same online information, legal actions and total budget.
validation.alpha_spending: For confirmation family j=1,2,... allocate two-sided alpha_total=0.05/(j*(j+1)), split equally across pickup and delivery and Bonferroni across registered contrasts and cohorts within each line; exploratory pilot 95% CIs are descriptive only.
validation.statistical_method: Independent complete days or snapshots, paired percentile bootstrap with predeclared counts/seed; Monte Carlo tail precision checked before confirmation. No formal discovery if sample/coverage assumptions are unsupported.
validation.sample_size: First mechanism pilot is bounded exploratory n=32, no power claim. Dynamic n=40/cohort is a resource boundary; plan detectable-effect/precision before confirming, no interim-significance expansion.

delivery_first_pilot.scope: exploratory snapshot attribution only; not same-time competitiveness or online gain

execution.current_gpu_policy: No team GPU until fresh availability audit; CPU-only initial engineering/mechanism tasks
execution.bounded_jobs: tmux for >5min; explicit wall timeout, own PID tree only; never kill team processes
execution.server_shared_md_upload: still pending explicit separate approval, do not retry
execution.physical_scope: literature-based simulation; no own physical-calibration claim or universal calibration barrier
